title: Nexitally node parser fixtures
notes: Every host, password, and UUID is reserved example data.
These files imitate a managed full Quantumult X configuration. They are not a Nexitally export.

cases.name: happy-path
cases.description: Extract usable servers from a synthetic managed full configuration.

cases.name: happy-path-crlf-bom
cases.description: Same happy-path file after a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings.

cases.name: missing-section
cases.description: A profile without [server_local] must fail clearly.
cases.expectedError: Nexitally parser: [server_local] section was not found.

cases.name: placeholders-only
cases.description: Traffic, expiry, and [Premium] lines are not usable servers.
cases.expectedError: Nexitally parser: no usable server entries were found.

cases.name: empty-section
cases.description: An empty [server_local] section is the same as no usable servers.
cases.expectedError: Nexitally parser: no usable server entries were found.

cases.name: duplicates-and-comments
cases.description: Comments, padding, and exact duplicate lines are removed.

cases.name: mixed-protocols
cases.description: Keep anytls, shadowsocks, vmess, vless, trojan, http, and socks5.

cases.name: extra-sections
cases.description: Stop at the next [section] so filters and remotes never leak.

cases.name: unsupported-protocols
cases.description: Drop hysteria2, tuic, wireguard, bare ssr, and https aliases.

cases.name: chinese-exclusion
cases.description: Chinese traffic / expiry / plan words are excluded like the English ones.

cases.name: server-local-at-eof
cases.description: [server_local] may be the last section in the file.

cases.name: leading-whitespace-header
cases.description: Whitespace around the section header is tolerated.

cases.name: spaced-equals
cases.description: Protocol tokens may have spaces before '='.
